purpose: Sanitized fresh pre-apply live-evidence schema for RA Pro billing-company cutover. Distinct from RA_PRO_CUTOVER_PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_V1, published prior dry-run evidence, and applicator post-connect schema probes. Exact retained file bytes are SHA-pinned by tip authorization before production apply may prompt or connect.

authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.required_pre_apply_live_evidence_sha256: 64-hex lowercase SHA-256 of retained evidence file bytes (null while UNPUBLISHED)
authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.required_pre_apply_live_freeze: 40-hex executable freeze that sealed the intake tooling (null while UNPUBLISHED)
authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.required_pre_apply_live_evidence_tip: 40-hex tip that published the pin (null while UNPUBLISHED)
authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.required_pre_apply_live_bundle_source: 40-hex bundle-source companion identity when published (null while UNPUBLISHED)
authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.published_pre_apply_live_evidence.eviden: exact retained byte length when PUBLISHED

field_types.source_channel_classification: string (sanitized channel label only; no secrets)
field_types.collection_ended_at_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp string (must be >= collection_started_at_utc)
field_types.valid_until_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp string (must be strictly after UtcNow at gate time for apply start)

optional_agreement_fields.wrapper: optional object; when present, overlapping sanitized fields must agree with applicator
optional_agreement_fields.applicator: optional object; when present, overlapping sanitized fields must agree with wrapper

forbidden_content: Customer, firm, user, or tenant identifiers (including UUID/GUID shapes)
Stripe object ids (cus_*, sub_*, evt_*, in_*, pi_*, price_*, prod_*)
Credentialed database URLs (postgres:// or postgresql:// with user:password@)
Session secrets, API keys, tokens, PEM material, or connection strings
Raw SQL, request/response payloads, or unsanitized log excerpts
Live production deployment URLs used as authority beyond opaque vercel_deployment_id
Any open commerce-gate observation (observed must never be open)
fail_closed_conditions: PRE_APPLY_LIVE_PINS_UNPUBLISHED: required_pre_apply_live_* null/empty/invalid OR published_pre_apply_live_evidence.status UNPUBLISHED/missing
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_SHA_MISMATCH: SHA-256 of retained evidence bytes does not match required_pre_apply_live_evidence_sha256
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_OID: tip evidence fixture OID mismatch
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_BYTES: tip evidence fixture byte count mismatch
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_REPARSE: evidence path is a reparse point
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_MISSING: evidence path missing or unreadable
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_INVALID: malformed JSON, missing required fields, or wrong types
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL: protocol_id is not RA_PRO_CUTOVER_PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_V1
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_EXPIRED: valid_until_utc is not strictly after UtcNow
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_COLLECTION_WINDOW: collection window inconsistent with itself or valid_from/until
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_START_NOT_UNEXPIRED: apply start requires current validity (valid_from<=UtcNow<valid_until); unmet before credentials/DB
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_MERGE_BASE: serving_deployment.merge_base_ref is not exactly 19e8bd071bae5f8afed85340f50168d4ca8e5586
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_DEPLOYMENT: merge_contained_or_serving is not true or vercel_deployment_id missing
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_COMMERCE_GATE: commerce_gate.observed not absent|closed OR never_open is not true
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_PROTECTION: generated_production_preview_urls_protected / old_pre_gate_url_protected / custom_domains_public not all true
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_STRIPE: stripe_tcp1 enabled/events_allowlist/failed/pending/visibility fields fail exact checks
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_INVENTORY: ceremony_inventory is not total=4 / company_owned=3 / firm_owned=1 / classification=active_and_complimentary
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION: history/version/objects/billing_company_id/linked_firms fail exact checks
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_DELTA: unexpected_new_links!=0 OR unexpected_new_authorizing_slots!=0
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_LEDGER: webhook_ledger_non_terminal_count!=0
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_FORBIDDEN_CONTENT: retained JSON contains UUID / Stripe id / credentialed postgres URL / secret-like material
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_WRAPPER_APPLICATOR: wrapper/applicator present and disagree on overlapping sanitized fields
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_CONTRADICTION: contradictory counts or mutually exclusive boolean observations
PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_SUBSTITUTION_FORBIDDEN: historical precondition protocol or prior dry-run evidence frame offered as pre-apply live evidence
notes: Distinct from historical dry-run precondition evidence (RA_PRO_CUTOVER_PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_V1) and published prior dry-run evidence; those MUST NEVER satisfy this gate (PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_SUBSTITUTION_FORBIDDEN).

Apply must begin while valid_until_utc is strictly after gate UtcNow; fail closed before SecureString prompt, Node, or DB if the start condition is unmet (PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_EXPIRED / PRE_APPLY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_START_NOT_UNEXPIRED).

Expiry mid-transaction after a valid start is outside this gate's success path: the sealed applicator remains fail-closed on its own probes; this gate does not authorize starting when already expired.
Materialization: tip git cat-file only when published_pre_apply_live_evidence.status is PUBLISHED; argv/env/worktree path overrides are forbidden.
This file is a contract/schema document only. Do not treat example_shape nulls as production evidence.
No fresh production pre-apply live collection is authorized under unpublished pins; ceremonies must fail closed with PRE_APPLY_LIVE_PINS_UNPUBLISHED before credentials.
